title: Manufacturing
meta: Lean manufacturing consulting for Canadian SMEs: raise productivity, cut overhead and improve OEE, quality and delivery with a team-driven improvement approach.
h1: Streamline your operation, raise productivity and cut costs
lead: Customers want higher quality, lower prices and faster delivery, all at once. We help manufacturers improve operating margins, reduce overhead and free up capital using a practical Lean methodology your team owns.
intro: What does it take to compete in manufacturing today?

Your competitive edge depends on improving operating margins, reducing overhead costs and decreasing capital requirements while customers demand more. Chmltech looks beyond processes to products and people, including staff performance, management behaviour and use of technology. Through interviews with employees and managers, document reviews and direct observation on the shop floor, we target efficiency, cost and quality through effective organizational design. We target significant, measurable productivity gains and track them against your baseline KPIs. Most importantly, your team leads the change, building a culture of continuous improvement.
signs: OEE is unknown or well below what the equipment should deliver
Changeovers take longer than they should and vary by crew
Overtime and expediting are part of every week
Scrap and rework are absorbed rather than measured
challenges: Global competition and rising input costs squeeze operating margins, while overhead and capital needs keep growing.
Unplanned stops, slow changeovers and minor stoppages quietly erode OEE and force extra shifts or capital spending.
Customers expect higher quality and faster, more reliable delivery, leaving little room for scrap, rework or late orders.
Past initiatives faded because they were driven by outsiders or a report, not by the people who run the work.
services: We define key metrics for service levels, productivity, speed and quality, including OEE, and set the baseline used to measure every improvement.
We map key processes, analyze financial and operating data, observe the floor directly and review your management tools to design sustainable solutions.
Process observations separate value-added from non-value-added activity, exposing the constraints that limit your manufacturing capacity.
We apply Lean tools such as SMED, standard work and cell layout to shorten changeovers, cut WIP and improve flow.
A complete 5S assessment based on Lean and Six Sigma methods to discard waste and create a clean, safe and efficient workplace.
Introductory Lean thinking workshops, a change readiness assessment and management tools that turn strategy into daily activities everyone understands.

steps.label: Confirm customer order
steps.text: Sales confirms quantities, specifications and the promised date.

steps.label: Schedule the job
steps.text: Planning sequences the job on the line and checks material availability.

steps.label: Stage materials
steps.text: The warehouse stages materials at the line.

steps.label: Change over the line
steps.text: The line is stopped and set up for the next product. Long, unstandardized changeovers push the plant toward big batches and late orders.

steps.label: First-piece approval
steps.text: Quality checks the first piece. When it fails, settings are adjusted and the line waits for another approval.

steps.label: Run the order
steps.text: The line runs the order at standard rate.

steps.label: Pack and ship
steps.text: Goods are packed, labelled and shipped.

steps.label: Confirm and invoice
steps.text: Sales confirms delivery and invoices the customer.

config.fix_text: SMED moves setup work off the line while it is still running, and standard settings with a changeover checklist get the first piece right. The plant can run smaller batches and meet promised dates.

stages.label: Plan
stages.text: Pick a problem from the KPI board, measure the baseline and agree what to test.

stages.label: Do
stages.text: Run the change on one line or cell for a short, defined trial period.

stages.label: Check
stages.text: Compare results with the baseline: OEE, scrap, lead time or changeover time.

stages.label: Act
stages.text: Standardize what worked, update standard work and pick the next problem.

why.title: Why Chmltech for manufacturing
why.text: We bring an engineer's eye and a participative approach. We do not simply leave you with a report of recommendations; we engage your team through every step.
points: Our principal is a process engineer, so we combine technical understanding of equipment and processes with proven Lean and Six Sigma tools.
We look at staff performance, management behaviour and use of technology, not just process maps, to find the real causes of lost performance.
Your people are the key drivers of change and keep ownership of their processes, so improvements continue after we leave.

faq: What productivity improvement can we expect?
Every operation is different, so we do not promise a fixed number. We set a baseline for your KPIs at the start, agree targets with you and track measurable gains against that baseline throughout.
How do you work with our shop floor team?
We interview employees and managers, observe processes directly and run hands-on workshops. Your team helps design and test the changes, which is what makes them stick.
Do we need new equipment or software?
Usually not to start. Most early gains come from better flow, faster changeovers and standard work. Where technology or automation helps, we recommend it based on your data.
Can you run a 5S assessment on its own?
Yes. A 5S assessment is a practical starting point and often reveals quick wins in safety, organization and time lost searching for tools and materials.
